description: Construct a retained variable-width strip with explicit inner trims and outer joins, rejecting invalid topology.
output_invariants: Detached canonical finite data; deterministic declared order and no partial result. Region query witnesses refer supplied ring order, constructed visible rings canonical winding/start.

behavior.validation: Exact passive Object/null-prototype records, dense ordinary arrays with own data slots, no extras/accessors/symbols/coercion; finite binary64 inputs. Validate full carrier/domain before budget. Proxies outside interchange. Every ring has >=3 distinct vertices, implicit closure, nonzero signed area, no duplicate seam/vertex, adjacent backtracking, self-contact, or self-crossing. Holes are strictly inside outer and pairwise disjoint/non-touching. Either winding input; owned output outer CCW/hole CW. Filled membership is outer minus holes. Static validation checks shape/domain, including strip duplicate/reversal rules; exact region topology follows work preflight. Hatch projection/count arithmetic is needed before its budget as explicitly specified. Errors atomic, no mutation/aliases; output zeros positive. Work sums/products use exact integers and compare before allocation; runtime/allocation guarantees do not follow from budgets.
behavior.algorithm: Static validation requires open points length>=2 or closed length>=3, widths.length=points.length, positive finite widths, finite coordinates, supported cap/join, finite miterLimit>=1, and no adjacent equal centerline points (including closure) or exact reversal; then preflight. Each nonzero edge has a checked binary64 unit tangent and left normal. Compute side endpoint samples from width[i]/2. Straight tapered side sections connect adjacent samples linearly. At a noncollinear turn, classify inside and outside by the exact sign of the centerline cross product: a left turn has left inner/right outer; a right turn has right inner/left outer. The inner side intersects supporting tapered-side lines in exact dyadic/rational arithmetic. Its intersection must lie within both adjoining finite tapered-side sections, including endpoints; a parallel noncoincident pair or out-of-range intersection rejects INVALID_STRIP_TOPOLOGY. A coincident parallel pair shares its common vertex sample if one exists, otherwise rejects. Round the exact intersection once to nearest-even binary64, emit one trim sample and record INNER. If rounding is nonfinite, coincides with a required distinct neighboring sample, or makes topology invalid, reject INVALID_STRIP_TOPOLOGY. The outer side BEVEL emits incoming and outgoing samples. Outer MITER uses the exact rational supporting-line intersection only when the rounded point is distinct and exact squared distance from center vertex <= exact (halfWidth*miterLimit)^2; otherwise it falls back to BEVEL, including nonfinite or representation failure of the optional miter. Collinear same-direction edges share one side sample and mark CONTINUOUS; exact reversal or adjacent coincident centerline points is INVALID_INPUT. A nonfinite base tangent/normal/sample is NUMERIC_OVERFLOW. Validate each assembled ring with exact dyadic topology; only equal consecutive join samples are deduplicated. Invalid open outer ring, or closed output other than exactly one disjoint enclosing outer plus one hole, returns REJECTED INVALID_STRIP_TOPOLOGY. Output ring outer is CCW, hole CW; each normalized ring rotates to its lexicographically least [x,y] vertex (ties impossible in a valid ring). Left/rightBoundary keep traversal order, not ring winding. Accepted witness is NONE/all -1. Rejected witness is first invalid ring/edge/vertex in ring order; unavailable fields -1. LeftBoundary and rightBoundary both follow original centerline forward traversal, with incoming then outgoing samples at each outer bevel; neither boundary is reversed. Only visible rings are winding-normalized and lex-rotated. Exact left turn means positive cross under x/y coordinates, independent of canvas handedness.
behavior.work: N=points.length. One side can emit two samples at each join, so a closed pair of sides has at most 4N edges total; an open joined outer ring has at most 4N+4 edges including caps. Use conservative Emax=4N+4, Qmax=2, VRmax=Emax^2+8*Emax*Qmax+4*Qmax^2. W=32N+VRmax in exact integers. WORK_LIMIT iff W>maxWork before geometry/allocation. Counts are abstract allowances, not time/bytes.
behavior.environment: No RNG, clock, host renderer, file IO or implicit assets. Consistent caller coordinate units; SVG input explicitly millimetres. Other targets deferred.
behavior.numerics: Topology and clearance thresholds use exact rational arithmetic on supplied binary64 dyadics. Constructed offsets and stated display arithmetic use ordered binary64 with finite checks; no epsilon, snap or repair. Exact shared JSON vectors; additional analytic shape tests compare declared floating arithmetic abs1e-9+rel1e-12 while topology/IDs/order remain exact. Optional outer miter failure falls back exactly as specified.
behavior.native_surface: taperedStrokeStrip2D(input), named p5-package export with stable-code errors.
